evals.prompt: 幫 Skills/ado-devops 這個 skill 寫一份 manual.md
evals.expected_output: A comprehensive manual.md containing ASCII architecture diagram, execution flowchart, component table listing all 7 scripts with their commands, real CLI examples, developer guide, and error reference table.

assertions.name: manual_md_exists
assertions.description: manual.md file is created in the outputs directory

assertions.name: has_ascii_box_diagram
assertions.description: Output contains ASCII box-drawing characters used for architecture or flow diagrams (┌ ─ ┐ │ └ ┘ ├ ┤ ┬ ┴)

assertions.name: all_7_scripts_mentioned
assertions.description: All 7 ado-devops scripts are referenced: work_items, repos, core, search, setup, ado_client, wiki

assertions.name: has_flow_arrows
assertions.description: Output contains flow direction symbols (▼ → ─→) indicating a flowchart is present

assertions.name: has_cli_examples
assertions.description: Output contains real CLI command examples referencing python and scripts/

assertions.name: has_error_section
assertions.description: Output contains an error handling or troubleshooting section

evals.prompt: 為 Skills/tech-article-writer 這個 skill 生成技術說明文件
evals.expected_output: A manual.md that has a workflow diagram despite having no scripts, lists trigger keywords, describes the writing workflow steps (overview, structure, table, length, template), and does NOT reference a non-existent scripts/ directory.

assertions.name: manual_md_exists
assertions.description: manual.md file is created in the outputs directory

assertions.name: has_flow_diagram
assertions.description: Output contains a flowchart or workflow diagram even though the skill has no scripts

assertions.name: has_trigger_examples
assertions.description: Output includes trigger phrases or keyword examples for when the skill activates

assertions.name: no_phantom_scripts
assertions.description: Output does NOT reference scripts/ directory (this skill has no scripts)

evals.expected_output: A concise manual.md that accurately maps the 5-step GitNexus workflow, mentions gitnexus_query and gitnexus_context tools, and does not over-pad with generic filler content.

assertions.name: manual_md_exists
assertions.description: manual.md file is created in the outputs directory

assertions.name: gitnexus_tools_mentioned
assertions.description: Both main GitNexus tools are referenced: gitnexus_query and gitnexus_context

assertions.name: workflow_steps_present
assertions.description: The 5-step workflow is represented (mentions READ gitnexus:// resource pattern and query/context tools)

assertions.name: not_over_padded
assertions.description: The manual is not excessively long (word count reasonably proportional to the short source SKILL.md)
